title: “Label from Somewhere”: Reflexive Annotating for Situated AI Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on the process of making value judgments and 'moral evaluations' during AI alignment. It investigates how annotators' personal positionality affects their assessments of fairness and ethics, utilizing feminist epistemology as a core framework. This goes beyond a standard ethical considerations section by making the nature of moral and ethical judgment the primary subject of empirical study.
